title: ScrapForAI browser verification: use 127.0.0.1 not localhost, and mind the SSRF allowlist
body:
When driving a generated app through the ScrapForAI real-browser harness:

- Navigate to `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` -- NOT `http://localhost:<port>`. The harness's SSRF allowlist and the browser context resolve `127.0.0.1`; `localhost` is rejected/flaky.
- Fill the `#apiKey` field and reload BEFORE asserting authenticated content -- the first unauthenticated page load emits benign `401`s that are not failures.
- `Assert-RoutineGreen` treats any `console.error` as a failure, but a `theme.css` 404 (apps without a custom theme get this by design) and pre-auth `401`s are benign -- expect and ignore those two.
- Use strict/scoped locators (e.g. `#concept-<Name> form`); the shell nav container id is `#sideNav`. Search inputs are debounced -- wait after typing before asserting filtered rows.
